nodes.name: Events Data
nodes.summary: Static data module containing allEvents array with 12 event objects for CPF youth programs, including details like date, city, pathway, points, and descriptions.
nodes.languageNotes: JavaScript data module with exported array of event objects

nodes.name: Global Styles
nodes.summary: Global CSS with Tailwind directives (@import 'tailwindcss') and custom base styles for font family and scroll behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with Tailwind CSS v4 @import directive

nodes.name: Application Entry Point
nodes.summary: React application entry point that mounts the App component into the DOM with StrictMode enabled.

nodes.name: Explorer Page
nodes.summary: Full-screen event explorer with geospatial split layout, search bar, pathway/region filters, interactive map with clickable region pins, and a scrollable events list with booking functionality.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion animations and interactive SVG map

nodes.name: Home Page
nodes.summary: Main landing page featuring a luxury hero, animated statistics counters, ecosystem programs section, strategic pathways selector, AI-powered pathway wizard modal, and events section with filters.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion animated counters and modals

nodes.name: Login Page
nodes.summary: Full-screen login form with national ID and password fields, show/hide password toggle, loading state, alternative login options (Google, email), and decorative hero panel with gradient overlay.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion spring animations

nodes.name: Program Details Page
nodes.summary: Detailed program information page with full data for 13 programs, featuring breadcrumb navigation, image header, program type/mechanism/language metadata cards, overview, facilities list, degree offerings, and FAQ accordion.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with hardcoded program data and Framer Motion
